def update_display(self):
        # Update progress bars
        self.update_progress_bar(self.hunger_bar, self.hunger)
        self.update_progress_bar(self.thirst_bar, self.thirst)
        self.update_progress_bar(self.happiness_bar, self.happiness)

        # Change pet color based on happiness using Breeze colors
        if self.happiness > 70:
            color = self.colors['pet_happy']
        elif self.happiness > 30:
            color = self.colors['pet_okay']
        else:
            color = self.colors['pet_sad']

        self.pet_canvas.itemconfig(self.pet_id, fill=color)

    def update_progress_bar(self, canvas, value):
        """Update a progress bar with new value"""
        canvas.delete("all")  # Clear previous content

        # Background
        canvas.create_rectangle(0, 0, 200, 20, fill=self.colors['progress_bg'], outline='')

        # Progress fill
        fill_width = (value / 100) * 196
        if fill_width > 0:
            canvas.create_rectangle(2, 2, fill_width + 2, 18, fill=self.colors['progress_fg'],
                                   outline='', width=0)
